description: Fixed question set for a Knowledge Base assistant with web search on (#707). The Knowledge Base is nimbus_contract.txt alone. kind=kb: answered only by the document; kind=web: answered only by the web; kind=both: needs the document and the web. kb_fact is a substring of the document the answer must carry (null when the document has nothing to say). web_result is the scripted search result the CI test returns for the question: its body is placeholder text for the test, not a real fact; a real-model run judges the web part by a web_search call and a cited URL.
